verdicts.explanation: The paper states σ = 7.0 × 10−13 S cm−1 at 300 K for the pristine nondefective m-LBO supercell (Li4B4O8), derived from DFT CI-NEB barriers, so material, value, unit, temperature and computational origin all match. Secondary fields are null, which is correct because the paper gives no synthesis or sintering data.
The paper reports σ = 2.8 × 10−2 S cm−1 at 300 K for the boron-vacancy m-LBO supercell, which is the DFT-computed value in the body text. Material, value, unit, temperature and origin all match.
The paper reports σ = 8.3 × 10−3 S cm−1 at 300 K for the oxygen-vacancy m-LBO supercell, computed by DFT. Material, value, unit, temperature and origin all match.
